text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. One major change is automation, where machines do tasks that people used to do, like sorting data or answering simple questions. Many companies also use productivity tools powered by AI to help workers finish tasks faster and with fewer mistakes. However, AI is not replacing people completely. Instead, human-AI collaboration is becoming common, where workers use AI to support their decisions and creativity. This means some jobs are changing, and employees need new skills to work with these tools. In the future, adapting to AI will be important for success at work.
